frontmatter.author: Typeset

blocks.title: At a glance
blocks.intro: An opener starts a numbered section. It carries an **eyebrow**, an intro set slightly larger than body text, and an optional headline figure on the right.

blocks.caption: Scores are averages across five pages. The tick on each gauge marks the target of 90.

blocks.text: Body text sits in the text column, about 75 characters a line, with *italic*, **bold**, `inline code` and [links](https://example.com) available everywhere text is accepted.

blocks.title: What would make the biggest difference
blocks.body: Callouts are tinted, never dark, so headings and links inside them stay readable. Speed comes first: the pages are **five times** heavier than they need to be.

blocks.title: Accessibility
blocks.intro: The findings table gives each issue a severity badge, how often it was found, where, and what to do.

items.title: Product images have no alternative text
items.fix: Add a short written description to each image so screen readers can describe it.

items.title: The text size drop-down has no label
items.fix: Add a label so screen reader users know what it is for.

items.title: Text and background colours don't contrast enough
items.fix: Darken light or pastel text, particularly prices and links.

items.title: Links with no readable text
items.fix: Describe icon-only links, such as the logo and the account icon.

items.title: Page content isn't grouped into landmarks
items.fix: Use proper page structure: header, main content and footer.

items.title: Decorative images are announced
items.fix: Mark purely decorative images so assistive technology skips them.

blocks.title: Information
blocks.body: An information callout, in the neutral tone.

blocks.title: What's working
blocks.body: Every page has a unique title, and the site is served over HTTPS.

blocks.title: Worth checking
blocks.body: Two basket pages exist (/basket/ and /mycart/). Customers may land on the wrong one.

blocks.title: Fix first
blocks.body: A test page and a sample post are publicly visible and indexed by search engines.

blocks.title: Next steps
blocks.intro: Steps are numbered in the margin column and run on across groups, each with an effort estimate.

items.title: Delete the test page and the sample post
items.detail: Both are live and indexed. Removing them takes minutes.

items.title: Pick one basket page
items.detail: Redirect the other one to it so every link goes to the same place.

items.title: Add alternative text to product images
Cut the page weight
items.detail: Compress images, serve modern formats and remove unused scripts. The home page should drop from 7.7 MB to under 1.5 MB.

items.title: Fix colour contrast across the theme
items.detail: Darken the pastel text styles in one place, in the theme's stylesheet.

blocks.title: About this review
blocks.intro: Facts set out label and value, with labels in the margin column.

items.label: Pages checked
items.value: Home, Shop, Engagement rings, Ring category, a ring product page

items.label: Tools
items.value: Automated audits for accessibility, performance, SEO, content and security, plus a manual review

items.label: Scoring
items.value: Each type of problem costs points once, with a little extra when it appears many times.
